headline: Mercado Libre Q3 Revenue Surpasses $10 Billion
summary: Mercado Libre reported third-quarter revenue exceeding $10 billion, with a 33% year-over-year increase in platform sales and a credit portfolio reaching $17.9 billion.
why: Mercado Libre is the largest e-commerce and fintech ecosystem in Latin America, often serving as a bellwether for regional consumer spending.

impacts.name: Mercado Libre
impacts.why: Despite strong revenue growth, market reaction was negative, likely due to valuation expectations.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Investors reacted negatively to the earnings report despite the revenue milestone, suggesting the market had priced in higher growth expectations.
